geopolitics_summary: US-Iran tensions escalating with military strikes on tankers; Trump signals potential de-escalation post-midterms. Crude supply risk elevated; indirect TTF exposure via LNG arbitrage.

themes.headline: US military destroys Iranian oil tankers; escalation threatens crude supply
themes.why_it_matters: Disruption to Iranian crude exports tightens global oil markets; elevated Brent supports fuel-switch economics (coal-to-gas), raising marginal power costs and EUA via CCS incentives over weeks-months.

themes.headline: US LNG exports rise 23% in H1 2026; elevated capacity supports volumes
themes.why_it_matters: Higher US LNG supply improves US-Europe arbitrage dynamics; increases TTF-competing volumes, capping European gas prices and reducing thermal-gen fuel costs over months horizon.

themes.headline: EU data centers mandated to build own clean power; AI demand competition cited
themes.why_it_matters: Ribiera's proposal signals structural shift in power demand allocation; PPAs for renewable capacity reduce grid supply available to marginal thermal gen, potentially lifting DA/Cal+1 spreads if backstop capacity reductions bind.

themes.headline: Record global temperatures in August; fossil fuel burn flagged by EU observer
themes.why_it_matters: Sustained heat supports elevated AC load; precedent for persistent regional demand swings. Near-term (days-weeks) pressure on DA pricing; longer-term EUA upside via emissions intensity narrative.

themes.headline: US crude production on track for 2026 record; 13.8M b/d forecast
themes.why_it_matters: Record US crude supply softens global Brent; weakens fuel-switch incentive for European thermal generators, exerting downward pressure on marginal power prices and EUA (lower carbon intensity dispatch).

watchlist: State of the Union speech (von der Leyen): green/industrial policy signals; ETS, renewable targets, tech levy language.
EU procurement rulebook finalization (€600B lever): impact on wind/solar capex competition, renewable capacity timeline.
US midterm elections (November 2026): Trump de-escalation stance on Iran could reduce crude volatility; monitor for policy shifts on LNG export licensing.
EU budget/tax negotiations (Costa tour, France €60B proposal): potential carbon border tax, sectoral levies affecting power market cost structure.
